# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/{id}/assets/{attachment_id}

Get a single attachment of a release by its ID

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token (optional for public repos) · **ID:** `ep-352`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| attachment_id | path | integer (int64) | True |

## Response

**200** — api.Attachment

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Attachment ID |
| `name` | string | Filename |
| `size` | int64 | File size in bytes |
| `download_count` | int64 | Number of downloads |
| `created_at` | time.Time | Upload timestamp |
| `uuid` | string | Unique file identifier |
| `browser_download_url` | string | Download URL |

- **404** — Release or attachment not found, or attachment not in release, or draft release without write access

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Draft releases are only visible to users with write access to releases unit | authorization | release.IsDraft && !canAccessReleaseDraft(ctx) |
| Attachment must belong to the specified release | validation | attach.ReleaseID != releaseID |
| Release must belong to the current repository | validation | release.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| API token must have repository write scope to access draft releases | authorization | ctx.Data["IsApiToken"] == true && scope lacks write:repository |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Release ID not found | 404 | notFound | False |
| Attachment ID not found | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **Release not found** → checkReleaseMatchRepo → 404
- **Release repo mismatch** → checkReleaseMatchRepo → 404
- **Draft release without write access** → checkReleaseMatchRepo → 404
- **Attachment not found** → GetReleaseAttachment → 404
- **Attachment not in release** → GetReleaseAttachment → 404
